decisions.reason: As a recent, closely related hearing-care product, the custom earmold fits the firm's integrated specialist offering and should be given more time to build demand rather than being withdrawn after only one year.
The product is close to the firm's established hearing-system business and had dedicated website presentation, suggesting strategic relevance and sufficient market commitment to continue.

The vacuum thermoforming unit strengthens the firm's equipment and workflow portfolio for specialist medical-technology users and aligns well with its push toward efficient, integrated production solutions.
